analysis.reason: 최근 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI 33.5로 과매도 구간 진입. MACD 히스토그램 개선세는 미약한 수준. 5일 거래량 비율 0.57로 위축된 거래량 속에서 방향성 부재. 52주 위치 5.9%로 저점 부근. 6,496원 ATR 대비 손절폭 1.3배(8,445원) 설정 시 손절가 42,060원, 목표가 1.5배(12,670원) 설정 시 63,175원. 손익비 1.5 미충족. 41,000원 스윙 지지선 근접. 65,285원 스윙 저항선까지의 거리가 멀어 단기 매수 진입 부담.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintained wait-and-see stance for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI at 33.5 entering oversold territory. MACD histogram shows only slight improvement. Volume ratio at 0.57 indicates subdued trading, lacking directional conviction. Current price at 5.9% of 52-week range, near the lower end. With ATR of 6,496, a 1.3x ATR stop loss (8,445) would be at 42,060, and a 1.5x ATR target (12,670) would be at 63,175, failing the 1.5 risk-reward ratio. Approaching the 41,000 swing support. The distance to the 65,285 swing resistance is substantial, making short-term buy entry challenging.
analysis.weeklyConflict: 주봉 RSI 34.5, MACD 히스토그램 음전, ADX 29.7로 추세 형성 초기 국면. 일봉과 주봉 모두 약세 구간 진입. 특별한 충돌 없음.
analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly RSI at 34.5, MACD histogram negative, ADX at 29.7 indicating early trend formation. Both daily and weekly charts are in a bearish phase. No significant conflict.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (50,505 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (53,630 KRW / 63,197 KRW / 83,953 KRW): confirmed below short/mid-term trends
· Position vs SMA100/200 (102,386 KRW / 112,668 KRW): confirmed strong mid-to-long-term bearish trend
· 52-week position (5.9%) + current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (37.5→33.5): entering oversold territory, maintaining downward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (340.0387→196.8480): improving but no bearish reversal signal confirmed
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band 45,253 KRW): approaching lower band, band width relatively wide at 56.79%
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (41,000 KRW): 1.3x ATR distance, based on Pivot S1 (39,198 KRW)
· Swing resistance (65,285 KRW): break above expected to surpass mid-band (63,197 KRW) and Pivot PP (61,507 KRW)
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day low 50,200 KRW, 20-day low 50,200 KRW): Higher Low unconfirmed, sideways range
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.57x): subdued compared to 5-day average, reduced confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): RSI entering oversold, MACD slight improvement, subdued volume warrants caution
